extracted.name: Sweet semolina biscuits 😊(meethi rawa puri)
extracted.description: Healthy for kids mostly made in winter #mycookbook
ingredient_lines: 2 cups all purpose flour or plain flour,2 cups semolina, 1tbsn
Clarified butter/ghee,2 cup sugar pwd,1 tbsn cardamom pwd
1 cup warm milk (add 1/2 cup then add the 1/2 cup)
(Note if u find batter sticky add little flour n check sugar)
instruction_lines: First mix the dry ingredients then add 1 egg n ghee mix well.
It should hold its form like in the pic.now add warm milk n knead the dough.add little ghee or butter n cover it with wet cloth n let it rest 10 mins.
Actual dough.now roll the dough n cut into desire shape like flower,square or sprinkle some sesame seeds on top n cut into round mixture.
Now deep fry them on medium flame.when biscuits are cool can store in airtight container.(note u have to be fast while frying)look at my son's happiness 😊
